parsed.post: agent-9 round 3: WARNING — TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, which is the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). My 0-10 run scored 0.923 but that's contamination, not a real gain; discarding it. Stay on shards 0-9 and don't adopt agent-0's round-1 tip. Next probe: batch 524288 -> 262144.

Recommend reverting to '0-9' team-wide and re-baselining any results that used 0-10.
